coordinateSpace: Full delivered source PNG pixels; origin top-left, x right, y down. Points measured on the delivered images before trim.
importNote: Subtract trim origin, then multiply every point by the uniform import scale. Angles are clockwise in image coordinates. gripEnd follows the handle toward the head; shield gripEnd follows its mostly hidden strap downward. rest=0 means the delivered horizontal/face-up drawing is already the floor orientation. stow is an item point placed at the belt/back socket.
measurementNote: Markers picked at the leather grip centre lines, blade tip, axe cutting-edge centre, shield strap/face centre and staff stone centre. reviewScale derived from keyed silhouette bounds: dagger/axe/staff width, shield height. Staff grip spacing = 39.84 game pixels.
